item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\nfrom work import evaluate\\n\\nrequests = json.loads(Path('requests.json').read_text())\\npolicy = json.loads(Path('policy.json').read_text())\\nreport = json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())\\nassert report == [evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests]\\n\\n# Independent boundary probes: one relevant complete-state change among duplicates,\\n# missing-state equivalence, ignored and undeclared noise, canonical key ordering,\\n# and immutability.\\nprobes = [\\n    ({'declared':['b','a','b','gone'], 'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'same'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'noise':{'v':1}}, 'current':{'a':{'hash':'same','kind':'file'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'gone':{'kind':'missing'},'noise':{'v':2}}}, {'ignored':[]}, {'needs_review':True,'changed':['b']}),\\n    ({'declared':['skip','x'], 'saved':{'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}, 'current':{'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'9'},'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}}, {'ignored':['skip']}, {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n    ({'declared':['added','removed'], 'saved':{'removed':{'kind':'file','hash':'r'}}, 'current':{'added':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}}}, {}, {'needs_review':True,'changed':['added','removed']}),\\n]\\nfor request, probe_policy, expected in probes:\\n    before = copy.deepcopy((request, probe_policy))\\n    assert evaluate(request, probe_policy) == expected\\n    assert (request, probe_policy) == before\\nprint(json.dumps({'report_ok': True, 'independent_probes_passed': len(probes)}))\"]}"}
